settings.currenciesHint: Prices are entered in USD, RMB (CNY) or INR and always shown in that currency. Nothing is converted; totals are kept per currency.

settings.backupsHint: Nightly dumps of Twenty and Chatwoot are kept on the storage server (7 daily, 4 weekly). Downloads are available to the super admin in the backup browser; restores run from the command line with restore.sh.

hero.title: Source products from China,
hero.titleAccent: delivered to your business in India.
hero.sub: Tell us what you need. Our team in China finds and checks factories, sends you a clear quotation, and manages shipping and customs all the way to your door.

how.title: How it works
how.sub: Four clear steps from idea to container.
how.d1: Product, quantity, target price and photos — by form, phone or WhatsApp.
how.d2: Our China team shortlists verified factories, compares offers and arranges samples.
how.d3: One quotation with price, MOQ, lead time and validity — in USD, RMB or INR as agreed.
how.d4: Inspection, freight booking, customs clearance and tracking until delivery.

svc.title: Why work with us
svc.sub: One team on both sides of the border.
svc.ad: Visits and checks before you commit.
svc.cd: No hidden currency markups — every price shows its currency.
svc.dd: Sea and air shipments handled end to end.
svc.ed: Know where your order is at every stage.
svc.fd: Teams in India and China speak your language.
